name: decentralized-evoting-monorepo
description: Production-grade Decentralized E-Voting System powered by Hardhat, Solidity, Vite, React, Ethers.js v6, and Paillier Homomorphic Encryption.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.start:all: concurrently -k --names "NODE,APP" --prefix-colors "yellow,cyan" "npm run node" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:8545 && npm run deploy && npm run dev"
